texts: Historical census intervals (bars show interval means) and annual projection
note: History separates population growth, household-size change and census-measured net replacement. Other / unallocated combines extra space, vacancy, retirement-village adjustment and unexplained building; it may contain historical excess supply but is not a measured overbuild series. The 2023–2025 household bridge is consent-derived. From 2026, gross market excess and its payback are shown separately on the 17-month completion-timed Reference.
